newsitem.title: USA: Mediscience to start phase II trial.
newsitem.headline: Mediscience to start phase II trial.

text.p: Mediscience Technology Corp said on Wednesday that it has received U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval to start phase II clinical trials for its CD Scan medical device for early detection of cancer.

Under the FDA's investigational device exemption, the company is holding a study at the Sloan Kettering Cancer Research Center in New York on oral lukoplakia, a pre-cancerous condition of the mouth, Mediscience said.
The company is hoping that its device and its tissue fluorescence technology can provide cancer screening without resorting to a biopsy, Mediscience said.
